{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
file_path = '../data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Compute response rates by arm
treatment_response_rate = data[data['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = data[data['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

treatment_response_rate, control_response_rate, treatment_effect"}
